AI Diagnostic Decision Breakdown

Engine Health Index (EHI) Deterministic Contribution Breakdown

The Engine Health Index is computed deterministically from thermodynamic residuals, lubrication stability, and vibration metrics, strictly evaluated on TRUSTED sensor data.

Sensor Trust Shielding Rule: If a sensor is quarantined (e.g. frozen oil pressure transducer), its unphysical penalty is completely shielded from EHI. BAD SENSOR ≠ BAD ENGINE.
